summary: TryHard Holdings Limited filed a Form 6-K announcing a 10-for-1 reverse share consolidation approved by its board on July 6, 2026, effective August 10, 2026, to regain compliance with Nasdaq Marketplace Rule 5550(a)(2). Outstanding shares will reduce from 50,046,250 to approximately 5,004,625; no fractional shares will be issued. The shares continue trading under symbol THH with a new CUSIP. This corporate action is a recapitalization event aimed at maintaining listing, not a traditional special situation. Watch for Nasdaq compliance confirmation and potential delisting risk if price fails to hold above minimum bid.
